decisions.reason: The supplement range sells through established pharmacy channels, has its own page and costs little to carry, so holding the option remains worthwhile.
The skin and hair supplement fits the firm's consumer health push and is cheap to maintain, and nothing so far shows its value will not be realized.
The mushroom-based immune supplement is a low-visibility niche product, but demand for immune products since 2020 keeps its upside uncertain while carrying costs stay low.

Despite the 2018 recall, the valsartan generic seems to have survived in the firm's broad generics range, and keeping an approved product costs less than re-entering later, so it is held under close watch.
The OTC migraine triptan is a recent and distinctive self-medication option with its own page, and its prospects are still unresolved, so it is too early to abandon it.
